about_the_game:
Because it's not a 'fairytale' until a fairy tells it!

Fate's Theater is a card-based storyteller where two mischievous fairies—sparkling Fortune and velvet-dark Misfortune—compete to toy with mortal fates. Enchant your living cards, combine their destinies, and make secret wagers to determine whether your mortals experience delightful serendipity or become unwitting characters in wickedly amusing catastrophes — always in perfect rhyme!

“Where mortal fates take wicked swings,
You choose which fairy pulls the strings!”

FEATURES

  • Cosmic Tug-of-War — Shift mortal fates between delightful fortune and wicked misfortune.

  • Freely Combine Cards — Experiment with card combinations to discover 400+ hand-crafted micro-stories.

  • Dual-Outcome Narratives — Each micro-story concludes differently depending on the winning fairy.

  • Rhymes & Mischief — Every fate revealed through playful verses, making mischief deliciously poetic.

  • Simple Rules, Strategic Bets — Easy-to-learn mechanics with secretive wagers to tip fate's scales.

  • Reactive Ambience — Background hues and music dynamically shift with each fairy's triumph.

  • Cute Shadow Puppets — Adorable silhouetted characters in charming shadow theater aesthetics.

  • Quick Duels, Solo or Multiplayer — Short, narrative-rich matches playable alone or with a friend.

  • Whimsy & Wickedness — Equal parts cute and macabre, balancing playful charm with dark humor.

“Fortune's kiss, Misfortune's curse,
Who gets to write the final verse?”

content_descriptors.notes: Features poetic descriptions of violence and gore, served with a dark sense of humor.
